entities.summary: The Church of Sainte‑Libaire is the Roman Catholic parish church of La Broque, in the Bas-Rhin department of the Grand Est region, France. Dedicated to Saint Libaire, a Lorraine martyr of the 4th century, it is one of the main religious buildings of the Bruche Valley. Its slender bell tower, visible from afar, rises as a landmark in the heart of the village.
